ops.text: Customer may terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience upon 30 days' prior written notice to Vendor, in which case Vendor shall refund any prepaid Fees for the period after the effective date of termination. Vendor has no right to terminate this Agreement or any Order Form for convenience during a committed term.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives us no convenience exit from a three-year term, so we have inserted a new Section 9.4 letting Customer terminate on 30 days' written notice with a refund of prepaid Fees and barring Vendor convenience termination during a committed term, per our termination-for-convenience position. If helpful, we can discuss the fallback of 60-90 days' notice with a fee capped at 3 months' fees.
proposal.summary: Insert Section 9.4 giving Customer a 30 days' notice convenience termination right with pro-rata refund of prepaid Fees and no Vendor convenience right during a committed term

mappings.element: No more than 30 days' written notice.
No Vendor termination-for-convenience right during a committed term.
